title: Settings, jobs, logging and database
routing: Is this about Foundry's runtime config and plumbing: `.foundry/settings.json` and how it is read, defaulted, validated and saved (ConfigStore with JSON patch semantics and revisions, configFromSaved, defaultConfig / starterConfig / defaultAgents, validateConfig, registerConfigValidator, settingsChanges, readRepositorySettings for `.foundry/project.json`, the viewer's loadSettings / settingsConfig and the control / models / runtime settings routes), what the settings define (vendors, installationName, project agents with `extends` / `override`, `journal.rawMiddlewareDays`, wrapsThread and the unwrapped fresh install), live settings edits and the audit history; or the background job queue (BullMQ on Redis: createQueue, enqueueJob, initializeWorker, makeJob, makeSingletonJob, warmLayers), the logger (createConsolaLogger, createPinoLogger, logScope, LogScope, addLogBroadcast), or Postgres via Prisma (`prisma/schema.prisma` models, `bun run db:push`, `db:push:test`, `test:db`)? Plain jobs: 'save this setting', 'add a config check', 'what does a fresh install get', 'run this in the background', 'only the latest run should survive', 'tag these logs', 'capture this run's logs', 'push the schema'.
